strings.zh: 这里是连接关东地区{NEWLINE}和城都地区的交通要道,{CLEAR}向东走可以到达关东,{CLEAR}向南走则可以到达城都。
strings.en: This is the main route linking the Kanto{NEWLINE}and Johto regions.{SCROLL}Head east to reach Kanto, or south to{NEWLINE}reach Johto.

strings.zh: 前面是……白银山哦,{NEWLINE}强得令人害怕的精灵{CLEAR}栖息在这里。{SCROLL}你还是……{NEWLINE}不要去比较好。
strings.en: This way leads to... Mt. Silver.{NEWLINE}Terrifyingly strong Pokémon live out{CLEAR}there. You’d better... not go.
strings.notes: US 0361/1 | RV014: meaning: 你还是不要去比较好 is advice, not 'You’re not ready'

strings.zh: 等等！{SCROLL}前面可是……白银山哦,{NEWLINE}强得令人害怕的精灵{CLEAR}栖息在这里。{SCROLL}如果没有精灵联盟的许可,{NEWLINE}谁也不许通过这里！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Wait!{SCROLL}This way leads to Mt. Silver.{NEWLINE}Scary-strong Pokémon live out there.{SCROLL}No one may pass without the{NEWLINE}Pokémon League’s permission!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 前面是白银山哦。{NEWLINE}强得令人害怕的精灵{CLEAR}栖息在这里。{SCROLL}不过我想您身为联盟冠军,{NEWLINE}肯定没问题的。
strings.en: This way leads to Mt. Silver.{NEWLINE}Scary-strong Pokémon live out there.{SCROLL}But as League Champion, I’m sure you’ll{NEWLINE}be fine.

strings.zh: 您好,通过这里向北{NEWLINE}可以到达石英高原。{CLEAR}精灵联盟的总部就坐落在那里。
strings.en: Hello! Head north from here to reach{NEWLINE}Indigo Plateau.{SCROLL}That’s where the Pokémon League has{NEWLINE}its headquarters.

strings.zh: 我走遍了关东和城都的各大城市,{NEWLINE}费劲千辛万苦才凑齐这8个徽章,。
strings.en: I traveled to every big city in Kanto{NEWLINE}and Johto and went through so much to{CLEAR}get these eight Badges.

strings.zh: 左行　白银山{NEWLINE}右行　关东地区{SCROLL}挑战四天王{NEWLINE}向上直行！{SCROLL}这点小事,{NEWLINE}战胜冠军的你{CLEAR}应该就知道了吧！
strings.en: West to Mt. Silver.{NEWLINE}East to the Kanto region.{SCROLL}Go north for the Elite Four!{NEWLINE}But you should know that already,{CLEAR}since you defeated the Champion!

strings.zh: 我们家孩子非要吵着来石英高原{NEWLINE}一睹大会选手的风采,{CLEAR}真是拿他没办法。
strings.en: Our kid kept pestering us to come to{NEWLINE}Indigo Plateau to see the Conference{CLEAR}competitors.{SCROLL}We just couldn’t say no to him.

strings.zh: 阿金『来参加石英大会的训练家们{NEWLINE}真是太帅了,{CLEAR}我将来也要出门旅行收集徽章,{CLEAR}然后在石英大会上{CLEAR}展现我帅气逼人的一面！
strings.en: Gold: The Trainers here for the Indigo{NEWLINE}Conference are so cool!{SCROLL}Someday I’m gonna go on a journey and{NEWLINE}collect Badges too...{SCROLL}...and then show off how awesome I am{NEWLINE}at the Indigo Conference!

strings.zh: 我来这也没想过要拿什么名次,{NEWLINE}重在参与就好。
strings.en: I’m not here to place or anything.{NEWLINE}Taking part is what counts.

strings.zh: 我在缘朱市的烧焦塔辛苦练习喷火,{NEWLINE}就是为了能在石英大会上{CLEAR}释放出夺最目的火光。
strings.en: I practiced breathing fire like crazy at{NEWLINE}the Burned Tower in Ecruteak City...{SCROLL}...all so I could put on the most{NEWLINE}dazzling blaze at the Indigo{CLEAR}Conference.

strings.zh: 长太郎『Aiii——pom！
strings.en: Aibo: Aiii-pom!
strings.notes: 长太郎 = Gold's Aipom (Adventures), same as 尾太郎 → Aibo; Gold is a kid here (pre-journey cameo).

strings.zh: 阿桔『为了进一步锻炼自己,{NEWLINE}我每天都会来白银山修行。{CLEAR}难得在这里遇见你,{CLEAR}要一起拍张照片吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Koga: To train myself further, I come{NEWLINE}to Mt. Silver every day to hone my{CLEAR}skills.{SCROLL}It is rare to meet you here. Shall we{NEWLINE}take a photo together?{VAR:0200:0}
strings.notes: 阿桔 = Koga (the US line #14 said Janine; retranslated).

strings.zh: 阿桔『那就摆个忍者的专属姿势吧。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Koga: Then let us strike a proper ninja{NEWLINE}pose.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 阿桔『嗯,这照片不错。
strings.en: Koga: Hmm. A fine photo.

strings.zh: 阿桔『好吧,我还是专注于修行吧！
strings.en: Koga: Very well. I shall return to my{NEWLINE}training!

strings.zh: 相册容量已满,{SCROLL}请在电脑上{NEWLINE}整理相册中的照片。
strings.en: The photo album is full.{SCROLL}Please sort the photos in your album on{NEWLINE}a PC.

strings.zh: 您好,这里只允许持有{NEWLINE}8枚及以上徽章的高级训练家通过,{CLEAR}您貌似并没有达到要求呢。{SCROLL}请回吧。
strings.en: Hello. Only Senior Trainers with eight or{NEWLINE}more Badges may pass here.{SCROLL}It seems you don’t meet the{NEWLINE}requirement.{SCROLL}Please turn back.

strings.zh: 您已经拥有8枚徽章了！？{SCROLL}失礼了,请过去吧！
strings.en: You already have eight Badges!?{SCROLL}Pardon me. Please go ahead!

strings.zh: 您好,这里只允许持有{NEWLINE}8枚及以上徽章的高级训练家通过……
strings.en: Hello. Only Senior Trainers with eight or{NEWLINE}more Badges may pass here...

strings.zh: 嘿,未来之星！{NEWLINE}让我好好拍拍你的脸！
strings.en: Hey, future star! Let me get a good{NEWLINE}shot of your face!

strings.zh: 哦？又来了一位优秀的训练家。{NEWLINE}请问我可以采访您吗？
strings.en: Oh? Another outstanding Trainer! May I{NEWLINE}interview you?

strings.zh: 真是一位沉默少言的选手。
strings.en: What a quiet, reserved competitor.

strings.zh: 您觉得现在{NEWLINE}自己的竞技状态怎么样？
strings.en: How do you feel about your current{NEWLINE}form?

strings.zh: 您能凑齐8枚徽章一定很不容易吧,{NEWLINE}其中哪枚徽章的获得{CLEAR}让您印象最深刻呢？
strings.en: Collecting eight Badges can’t have been{NEWLINE}easy.{SCROLL}Which Badge left the strongest{NEWLINE}impression on you?

strings.zh: 我们这个采访{NEWLINE}以及石英大会的全程比赛,{CLEAR}都会向全地区的观众转播,{CLEAR}您要对电视机前的观众讲两句吗？
strings.en: This interview and every match of the{NEWLINE}Indigo Conference will be broadcast to{CLEAR}viewers across the region.{SCROLL}Would you like to say a few words to{NEWLINE}everyone watching at home?

strings.zh: 谢谢您接受我们的采访,{NEWLINE}祝您比赛顺利,取得佳绩！
strings.en: Thank you for the interview! Good luck{NEWLINE}in your matches. We hope you do great!

strings.zh: 快,摄影师,来拍一下这位选手。
strings.en: Quick, cameraman, get a shot of this{NEWLINE}competitor.

strings.zh: 非常棒,我现在斗志昂扬
strings.en: Great! I’m totally fired up

strings.zh: 不太行,我没什么信心
strings.en: Not great. I’m not confident

strings.zh: 没感觉,我的心情很平静
strings.en: Nothing special. I’m calm

strings.zh: 灰色徽章
strings.en: Boulder Badge
strings.notes: Badge list #31–38 in hack order: 灰色 Boulder, 蓝色 Cascade, 橙色 Thunder, 彩虹 Rainbow, 浅红 Soul, 深红 Volcano, 黄金 Marsh, 绿色 Earth.

strings.zh: 蓝色徽章
strings.en: Cascade Badge

strings.zh: 橙色徽章
strings.en: Thunder Badge

strings.zh: 彩虹徽章
strings.en: Rainbow Badge

strings.zh: 浅红徽章
strings.en: Soul Badge

strings.zh: 深红徽章
strings.en: Volcano Badge

strings.zh: 黄金徽章
strings.en: Marsh Badge

strings.zh: 绿色徽章
strings.en: Earth Badge

strings.zh: 感谢妈妈、大木博士
strings.en: Thanks, Mom and Prof. Oak

strings.zh: 感谢我的朋友、精灵
strings.en: Thanks, friends and Pokémon

strings.zh: 大家也一起来收服口袋妖怪吧
strings.en: Everyone, go catch Pokémon!

strings.zh: 没什么想说的
strings.en: Nothing to say

strings.zh: 来石英高原之前我信心满满,{NEWLINE}但是来到这里之后{CLEAR}看到参赛选手们都很厉害的样子,{CLEAR}瞬间就没信心了。
strings.en: I was so confident before I came to{NEWLINE}Indigo Plateau.{SCROLL}But once I got here and saw how strong{NEWLINE}the other competitors looked, my{CLEAR}confidence vanished.

strings.zh: 我是从城都地区赶来的,{NEWLINE}这次一定要在石英大会上取得名次！
strings.en: I came all the way from Johto. This time{NEWLINE}I’m going to place at the Indigo{CLEAR}Conference for sure!

strings.zh: 等等！{SCROLL}前面可是……白银山哦,{NEWLINE}如果没有精灵联盟的……
strings.en: Wait!{SCROLL}This way leads to Mt. Silver. Without{NEWLINE}the Pokémon League’s...

strings.zh: 哦哦,是{VAR:0103:0}先生啊！{NEWLINE}我已经接到通知了,您是来养伤的吧？{CLEAR}精灵联盟专门为您安排了康复师,{CLEAR}她已经在山脚下的小屋等着您了,{CLEAR}您过去找她就可以了。
strings.en: Oh! It’s Mr. {VAR:0103:0}! I’ve been{NEWLINE}notified. You’re here to recover from{CLEAR}your injuries, right?{SCROLL}The Pokémon League has arranged a{NEWLINE}physical therapist just for you. She’s{CLEAR}waiting for you in the cabin at the foot{CLEAR}of the mountain. Just go see her there.
strings.notes: #46 (male player, 先生) / #47 (female player, 小姐): same English. | RV014: omission: honorific 先生

strings.zh: 哦哦,是{VAR:0103:0}小姐呀！{NEWLINE}我已经接到通知了,您是来养伤的吧？{CLEAR}精灵联盟专门为您安排了康复师,{CLEAR}她已经在山脚下的小屋等着您了,{CLEAR}您过去找她就可以了。
strings.en: Oh! It’s Ms. {VAR:0103:0}! I’ve been{NEWLINE}notified. You’re here to recover from{CLEAR}your injuries, right?{SCROLL}The Pokémon League has arranged a{NEWLINE}physical therapist just for you. She’s{CLEAR}waiting for you in the cabin at the foot{CLEAR}of the mountain. Just go see her there.

strings.zh: 白银大会即将召开,{NEWLINE}我现在在这里负责审查{CLEAR}去参加大会的训练家的徽章数量。
strings.en: The Silver Conference is about to begin.{SCROLL}I’m in charge of checking the Badges of{NEWLINE}Trainers heading to the Conference.

strings.zh: 听说今年的石英大会{NEWLINE}设在了白银山举行,{CLEAR}并更名为白银大会。{CLEAR}平时白银山可都是禁止出入的,{CLEAR}这下就算是为了看看白银山,{CLEAR}也要报名参加大会啊。
strings.en: I heard this year’s Indigo Conference{NEWLINE}is being held on Mt. Silver and renamed{CLEAR}the Silver Conference.{SCROLL}Mt. Silver is normally off-limits, so even{NEWLINE}if it’s just to see the mountain, I’ve{CLEAR}got to sign up!

strings.zh: 我来这里的路上,{NEWLINE}听说今年的大会改在白银山举行了。{CLEAR}也不知道是不是真的。
strings.en: On my way here, I heard this year’s{NEWLINE}Conference was moved to Mt. Silver.{SCROLL}I wonder if it’s true.
